LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Ambush_Tip: Strike the wagons on the open road. The escort carry the atium on their persons, a bead apiece, so nothing is yours until they are down. The Ministry will not forget who struck first.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Bribe_Tip: Offer the captain silver to look away. He brings the atium to you himself and the wagons roll on. Quieter than steel, and the Ministry need never know.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Reward_FirstBead: A single bead of Lerasium, if it survives the road
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Title: One bead, and three ways to spend it
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Blurb: The bead is warm from the road, no larger than a fingertip. Choose. There will not be another.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Drink_Tip: One colonist becomes Mistborn. There is no second bead.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Drink_Blocked: No colonist stands free to take the bead.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Give_Tip: A permanent ally, and a Mistborn of theirs who comes when you are pressed.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Hide_Tip: Keep the bead. Decide later. Understand that others will come looking.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Hide_Confirm: The bead stays hidden, tucked away for another day.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_BeadMissing: The bead is gone. There is nothing left to spend.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Choice: Decide how the wagons will be taken.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Travel: Reach the transfer road before the convoy passes.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Clear: Put down the escort, then search them. Each carries a bead. Obligators do not surrender wagons.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Hathsin_Stage_Travel: Follow the survivor's map to the Pits, past where the obligators cared to dig. Ministry soldiers hold the seam. Take it from them.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Pits_Stage_Travel: Reach the Pits of Hathsin. Not the seam this time - the farm itself, and the garrison the Lord Ruler keeps on it.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Pits_Stage_Carry: Strip every crystal face in the basin. Come and go as you need - what you take does not grow back, and the Ministry will keep sending men while the ground is still worth holding.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Inquisitor_Stage_Travel: Find the waypoint the Inquisitor has taken for itself, before it finishes working outward to you.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Inquisitor_Stage_Clear: Put it down. Spikes through the eyes, and it still will not stop while it can stand.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Hathsin_Stage_Carry: Cut geodes from the seam and bring at least twenty home. Leave whenever you like.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Stage_Infiltrate: Reach the vault the obligator named.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Stage_Breach: Break the garrison holding the vault.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Lerasium_Stage_Carry: Carry the bead home. Do not lose it on the road.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Hathsin_GeodesCracked: {GEODES} geodes are split open. {BEADS} of them held atium.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Reward_GeodeConversion: Atium from every geode carried home
